description: A pivot mode toggle for the Svelte 5 data grid built on SvPivotDesigner with panelPosition='right', which docks the field checklist and the Columns, Rows and Values wells as a tool panel beside the grid. With pivot mode off, flatColumns renders the flat participant grid with column groups, flags, ratings and an inline filter row; on, the grid pivots Language and Country against Game with averaged measures, and decorateColumns heat-tints the values from low to high. The layout is pre-seeded so the switch yields a real cross-tab immediately.
keywords: svelte cross tab from flat grid

faq.question: How do I show the normal grid when pivot mode is off?
faq.answer: Pass flatColumns to SvPivotDesigner with the columns for the flat view and bind pivotMode. Off renders those columns over the raw rows; on renders the pivot from the wells.

faq.question: How is the heat tint applied?
faq.answer: decorateColumns receives the generated value columns and returns them with a cellClass or style computed from the column's value range, so the tint follows the data.

faq.question: Can the panel sit above the grid instead?
faq.answer: Yes. panelPosition accepts top, the default where the field rail and wells sit above the pivot, or right for the docked tool-panel look used here.
